observations: I looked at 01-2.png, the cast sheets and page-01.png. Meera matches the sheet: large round eyes with a visible lower lash line, thin arched brows set high, a round face, a small hoop earring, a braid over her left shoulder and the white-printed blue kurta.

Her hands match the record. Her left hand holds the corded beige receiver to her left ear, and her right hand, with the silver bangle on the right wrist, writes in the open register with a pen. The pen grip and the fingers wrapped around the receiver are clean, and the cord runs to the base on the desk.

The acting fits the beat: raised brows, a sweat drop and an open mouth read as flustered but friendly. The stack of closed registers has blank spines and the open register has only ruled blank lines, so there is no readable writing.
Three patients in the foreground queue are seen only from behind. Grey perforated waiting chairs and a potted plant match the morning reception of 01-1.

Minor: ringing motion lines are drawn next to the receiver even though she has already answered. Readers will take them as the general phone noise of the beat, so this is not a defect. The empty upper half of the panel holds both balloons in the composite without covering her face.
